description: On the desk in front of you are a shallow game box with a small hammer and a Rubik’s cube inside, plus a black stapler, a gray smartphone, red-and-yellow pliers, and a rainbow pop-it toy. The left hand stays open near the left side of the box while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the stapler as a right-hand object, lifts it off the desk, and moves it leftward to set it down inside the box before releasing it.
